description: Fix v5 walkthrough issues: add git commit instruction to coder agent prompts, use entrypoint.sh in walkthrough

tasks.title: Add git commit instruction to coder agent task prompt
tasks.spec: specs/container-init-process/spec.md#Requirement: Coder agent commits changes after each task
tasks.description: In `packages/cli/src/openspec/context-assembler.ts`, modify `buildTaskContext()` to append a git commit instruction at the end of `fullPrompt`. The instruction should tell the agent: after completing the task, run `git add -A && git commit -m "<task-id>: <brief summary>"` to persist changes. Add this as a new section after the task prompt, using a clear delimiter like `[Post-Task Instruction]`. This ensures each task's code changes are committed before the next task starts.
acceptanceCriteria: `buildTaskContext()` returns a `fullPrompt` that ends with a git commit instruction
The instruction includes `git add -A` and `git commit` commands
The instruction references the task ID in the commit message template
tasks.notes: Do NOT remove or change `commitBuildChanges()` in workflow-controller.ts — it serves as a safety net for bulk commit after all tasks complete.

tasks.title: Update walkthrough SKILL.md to use entrypoint.sh instead of sleep infinity
tasks.description: In `.opencode/skills/mohist-walkthrough/SKILL.md`, update Step 3 to use `entrypoint.sh` instead of `sleep infinity`. Change the `podman run` command to: `podman run -d --name "$CONTAINER_NAME" -v "$RESULT_DIR:/app/results:z" mohist-walkthrough` (remove the `sleep infinity` CMD override). The container's ENTRYPOINT (`/entrypoint.sh`) will auto-start mo-server and handle signals. Also update the verification step to check health as before.
acceptanceCriteria: SKILL.md Step 3 `podman run` command no longer includes `sleep infinity`
The command lets the default ENTRYPOINT handle container startup
